triggerList.name: trg_sales_no_negative_total
triggerList.raw: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_sales_no_negative_total BEFORE UPDATE ON sales WHEN NEW.total_minor < 0 OR NEW.amount_paid_minor > NEW.total_minor BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SALE_ARITHMETIC_VIOLATION'); END;

triggerList.name: trg_sales_credit_allowed
triggerList.raw: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_sales_credit_allowed BEFORE INSERT ON sales WHEN NEW.remaining_balance_minor > 0 BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.customer_id IS NULL THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Vente à crédit : choisissez un client autorisé au crédit.')

triggerList.name: trg_sales_credit_allowed_update
triggerList.raw: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_sales_credit_allowed_update BEFORE UPDATE OF remaining_balance_minor, customer_id ON sales WHEN NEW.remaining_balance_minor > 0 BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.customer_id IS NULL THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'Vente à crédit : choisissez un client autorisé au crédit.')
